request-katelyn.subject: An introduction to Ethan Jacks?
request-katelyn.body:
Hi Katelyn,

I’d like to introduce you to Ethan Jacks, co-founder and managing partner at MediaBridge Capital Advisors. He advises media and technology companies on M&A and exits.

Your work helping founders raise capital at Grant Drive Group seems complementary: some of your clients may eventually need exit advice, while companies in his pipeline may need capital before a sale. His media-tech network could also be relevant to your work at Orbiter.io.

Would you be open to an introduction? I’ll connect you both if you’re both comfortable.

Mark

request-ethan.subject: An introduction to Katelyn Gallanty?
request-ethan.body:
Hi Ethan,

I’d like to introduce you to Katelyn Gallanty. She helps founders raise capital from pre-seed through Series B at Grant Drive Group and is CFO of Orbiter.io.

I see a possible fit with your M&A and exit advisory work at MediaBridge: her founder clients may eventually need a sell-side specialist, and companies in your pipeline may need capital before they’re ready for an exit. It could be useful to compare notes on referrals in both directions.

Would you be open to an introduction? I’ll connect you both if you’re both comfortable.

Mark

final.subject: Introducing Katelyn Gallanty and Ethan Jacks
final.body:
Katelyn, meet Ethan. Ethan, meet Katelyn.

Thank you both for being open to connecting. Katelyn helps founders raise capital at Grant Drive Group and is CFO of Orbiter.io. Ethan co-founded MediaBridge Capital Advisors, where he advises media and technology companies on M&A and exits.

I thought your work could complement each other across the founder lifecycle, from raising capital to planning an exit. There may be opportunities to refer founders whose needs sit between your specialties. The overlap with media and technology operators also seemed worth a conversation.

I’ll leave you two to compare notes.

Mark
